text: 1、市场早间震荡分化，创业板指高开低走。煤炭板块集体走强，云煤能源、郑州煤电、大有能源涨停。航运板块拉升，南京港、招商轮船、海通发展涨停。军工板块盘中异动，亚星锚链、湖南天雁涨停。下跌方面，传媒、短剧概念调整，出版传媒跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市约3500股飘绿，上午半天成交1.22万亿。午间收盘沪指涨0.24%，深成指跌0.06%，创业板跌0.34%。 2、板块概念方面，煤炭、航运、军工、培育钻石等板块领涨；传媒、游戏、短剧、数字货币等板块领跌； 3、两市共1739只个股上涨，42只个股涨停；3300只个股下跌，4只个股跌停；27只股票炸板，炸板率3
text_en: 1. Markets diverged in early morning trading; ChiNext opened higher but fell. Coal sector rallied collectively, with Yunmei Energy, Zhengzhou Coal Industry, and Dayou Energy hitting limit up. Shipping sector surged, with Nanjing Port, China Merchants Energy Shipping, and Haitian Development hitting limit up. Defense sector moved intraday, with Yaxing Anchor Chain and Hunan Tianyan hitting limit up. On the downside, media and short-drama concepts adjusted, with Publishing Media hitting limit down. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with about 3,500 stocks across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets turning green; morning turnover was 1.22 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.24%, Shenzhen Component fell 0.06%, and ChiNext fell 0.34%. 2. By sector concept, coal, shipping, defense, and lab-grown diamonds led gains; media, gaming, short-drama, and digital currency led losses. 3.
